en_us.title: Modpack Update Available
message: A new modpack version is available.
Current version: {current_version}
Latest version: {latest_version}
Update highlights:
Main Content:
[+] Added two Ultimate Skills: Azathoth, God of the Void and Velgrynd.
[+] Updated Wrath King · Satanael: players now regenerate 1% MP per second while its combat buff is active.
[+] Milim now appears as a boss in the open world. Stay tuned for a dedicated structure!
[+] Prevented players from farming EP using clones.
[+] Improved the display of Luminous in her chibi form.
[+] Added the cookFoodEP game rule, which allows the Cook skill to give food EP.
[+] Added two Easter egg items, obtainable by defeating Rimuru and Luminous, respectively.
[+] Players are now shown the supported language options when opening the quest book for the first time in a world.
[+] Updated several mods to improve gameplay and stability, added a few Unique Skills, and fixed some longstanding bugs.
[+] Improved and adjusted Diablo's AI:
- Melee damage multipliers: Right Slash 0.8×, Left Slash 1.0×, Cross Slash 1.3×, Thrust 1.1×, Rising Slash 1.2×, Heavy Strike 1.6×, and Triple Strike 0.6× per hit.
- Diablo can now use a body double to maneuver behind players, use Seducer, block players' spellcasting for 120 seconds, and perform defensive counterattacks.
[+] Increased Diablo's spawn rate in the Nether.
[+] Added Nature's Compass to help players locate biomes.
[+] Consuming a Time Crystal now increases Time Travel mastery by 25%.
Mortal Cultivation DLC:
[+] Added three biomes: Spirit Forest, Sky Spirit Forest, and Nine Nether Cold Pool.
[+] Added the Azure Moss Qilin miniboss and the Monkey mob.
[+] Reworked the Monkey race: improved its evolution progression and models, and adjusted its skill types.
[+] Added the Heaven and Earth Manifestation Manual.
Fixes and Stability:
[+] Fixed several minor issues from the previous version.
[+] Fixed an issue where Rimuru would not drop loot when defeated in his first phase.
[+] Fixed the Unique Skill Restricted appearing on unintended races.
[+] Fixed an issue where the Orc Disaster could pick up Training Dummies.
[+] Fixed Time Travel resetting the contents of players' Sophisticated Backpacks.
[+] Fixed Time Travel sound effects playing indefinitely.
[+] Fixed world corruption caused by surface rules.
[+] Fixed an issue where loot chests sometimes required two attempts to open.
[+] Improved stability.

zh_cn.title: 发现整合包新版本
message: 检测到整合包有新版本。
当前版本：{current_version}
最新版本：{latest_version}
更新内容：
主内容：
[+] 新增两个究极技能：虚空之神·阿撒托斯、灼热之王·维尔格琳。
[+] 调整愤怒之王·萨塔纳尔：在战斗状态 Buff 下，玩家每秒回复 1% MP。
[+] 米莉姆作为 Boss 出现在大世界中，专属结构敬请期待！
[+] 防止玩家通过分身刷取 EP。
[+] 优化露米娜丝小人状态的显示。
[+] 新增游戏规则 cookFoodEP，允许料理人技能赋予食物 EP。
[+] 添加两个彩蛋道具，分别击败利姆露和露米娜丝即可获得。
[+] 玩家在存档中第一次打开任务书时，会显示支持的语言选项。
[+] 更新多个模组以改善游戏体验与稳定性，新增几个独特技能，并修复一些遗留问题。
[+] 优化并调整迪亚波罗的 AI：
- 现在会使用替身绕后、独特技能诱惑者、持续 120 秒的魔法释放封锁，以及防守反击。
[+] 提高迪亚波罗在地狱的刷新率。
[+] 添加自然指南针模组，方便玩家定位群系。
[+] 服用时间结晶现在可以增加 25% 的时间旅行熟练度。
修仙 DLC：
[+] 新增三个群系：灵气之森、浮岛灵气之森、九幽寒潭。
[+] 新增小 Boss 苍苔灵麒与生物猴子。
[+] 调整猴子种族：优化进化流程与模型，并调整技能类型。
[+] 添加法天象地秘籍。
问题修复与稳定性：
[+] 修复上个版本存在的一些小问题。
[+] 修复利姆露在第一阶段被击败后不掉落战利品的问题。
[+] 修复独特技能「受限」出现在不应获得该技能的其他种族上的问题。
[+] 修复猪头魔王能够抱起训练人偶的问题。
[+] 修复时间旅行会重置玩家精妙背包内物品的问题。
[+] 修复时间旅行音效持续播放的问题。
[+] 修复地表规则导致存档损坏的问题。
[+] 修复战利品箱有时需要尝试打开两次的问题。
[+] 提高稳定性。
请到官网或者夸克网盘下载整合包。
